info.title: PRKS API
info.description: The PRKS HTTP API, generated from the route table (backend/api) and the Pydantic boundary models (backend/api_contract). Every /api/ request needs a live session; a mutation also sends the PRKS-Library-Epoch header.

get.summary: Download a published backup archive

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The `ready` line's token.

404.description: No published archive with that token (unknown_token).

post.summary: Make a backup and stream its progress
post.description: Queues the Library's backup job, or follows the one already queued or running.

parameters.name: PRKS-Library-Epoch
parameters.description: The Library epoch the client acted on (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED, LIBRARY_EPOCH_CHANGED).

requestBody.description: A JSON object, ignored; may be left out. Left out, the request still sends Content-Type: application/json (else 415).

200.description: One JSON object per line until `ready` (with the download token) or `failed`.

schema.description: Newline-delimited JSON: each line is one BackupProgressLine object.

post.summary: Restore a staged archive over the Library

parameters.name: PRKS-Library-Epoch
parameters.description: The Library epoch the client acted on (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED, LIBRARY_EPOCH_CHANGED).

400.description: No `confirm: RESTORE` (confirmation_required) or an unknown token (unknown_token). Also: The body is not one JSON object, or not JSON (invalid_request), or no or a malformed PRKS-Library-Epoch header (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED).

409.description: The restore failed and nothing changed (`reason`). Also: PRKS-Library-Epoch names another epoch than the Library's (LIBRARY_EPOCH_CHANGED).

507.description: The archive could not be copied for the restore; nothing changed.

post.summary: Upload a backup archive and verify it for a restore

parameters.name: PRKS-Library-Epoch
parameters.description: The Library epoch the client acted on (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED, LIBRARY_EPOCH_CHANGED).

200.description: Verified; the token names it to the restore.

400.description: A bad Content-Length (invalid_request), or an archive that failed verification (`reason`). Also: No or a malformed PRKS-Library-Epoch header (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED).

post.summary: Upload one PDF into the queue
post.description: The body is the PDF. A used `Idempotency-Key` answers with its item without reading the body. Any answer sent before the whole body was read carries `Connection: close`. Duplicates by content are a warning only.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Minted by the client per file: 1-128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`.

parameters.name: PRKS-Filename
parameters.description: The original filename, percent-encoded UTF-8; display only.

parameters.name: PRKS-Library-Epoch
parameters.description: The Library epoch the client acted on (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED, LIBRARY_EPOCH_CHANGED).

200.description: The key was used: its item.

400.description: A bad Idempotency-Key, filename or Content-Length (VALIDATION_ERROR), or a body shorter than Content-Length (PROCESSING_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE). Also: No or a malformed PRKS-Library-Epoch header (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED).

408.description: The body stalled for 30 seconds, or did not arrive within 60 seconds plus its length at 256 KiB/s (PROCESSING_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT).

409.description: The key's item was deleted (PROCESSING_ITEM_DELETED), or the uploaded bytes are missing or no longer match the upload's size or version, and no item was registered (PROCESSING_OBJECT_MISSING). Also: PRKS-Library-Epoch names another epoch than the Library's (LIBRARY_EPOCH_CHANGED).

415.description: Not sent as application/pdf (unsupported_media_type), or the body does not start with %PDF- (PROCESSING_NOT_A_PDF).

post.summary: Import several items, each in its own transaction
post.description: One item's failure never affects another's: each has its own result.

200.description: A result per item, in order.

400.description: item_ids missing, empty, not strings, or more than 500, or another key sent (VALIDATION_ERROR). Also: The body is not one JSON object, or not JSON (invalid_request), or no or a malformed PRKS-Library-Epoch header (LIBRARY_EPOCH_REQUIRED).

description.description: Optional markdown description. Omitted → empty string. When supplied must be a string (not null). Domain enforces length/control rules.
description.title: Description

PositionDetail.description:
Detail / create / update response including Arguments targeting this Position.

Exact wire contract: ``arguments`` is always present (may be empty).

PositionSummary.description:
Index row from GET /api/positions (no embedded arguments).

Exact wire contract: established keys are required (nullable where the
DB allows null). Unknown keys are forbidden so GET dump_response cannot
silently drop or invent fields.

PositionSyncFields.description: Exact Position revision map — always ``name`` and ``description``.

name.description: When present, must be a string. Omit to leave unchanged. Explicit JSON null is invalid.
name.title: Name

description.description: When present, must be a string (empty string clears). Omit to leave unchanged. Explicit JSON null is invalid.
description.title: Description

ProcessingDuplicates.description:
Other ``ready`` items and Works of this Library with the same bytes: a warning only.

Each list names at most ten (items oldest first, Works by id); ``more_*``
says whether there are more.

ProcessingFileRole.description: A staged person role, in inbox order.

ProcessingFileRoleInput.description:
A staged role as the endpoint accepts it.

An item without a person or role type is skipped. A duplicate
person/role pair keeps its first position.

ProcessingFileTagInput.description: A staged tag as the endpoint accepts it. ``tag_id`` is read when ``id`` is empty.

ProcessingImportRequest.description: POST /api/processing-items/import: the items to import, each in its own transaction, in order.

ProcessingImportResult.description: One item's outcome: ``work_id`` when it imported, else ``code`` (and ``item`` when there is one).

ProcessingItem.description: One queue item: a ``ready`` item with its draft, or an ``imported`` or ``deleted`` marker.

ProcessingItemDraft.description: The Work a ``ready`` item will become, as the user drafts it.

ProcessingItemImported.description: POST /api/processing-items/{id}/import: the Work (201 created, 200 for an import already done).

ProcessingItemPage.description: GET /api/processing-items: one page of ``ready`` items, oldest upload first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

ProcessingItemRefusal.description:
Every refusal on these routes.

The queue's own refusals and admission's authorization refusals carry
``code`` and ``message`` (and ``item``, as it now is, when there is
one). Refusals decided before admission or the route (Host, Origin, the
JSON body reader, an unavailable database) carry ``error`` alone.

ProcessingItemUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /api/processing-items/{id}. ``revision`` is required; omit a field to leave it unchanged.

Draft values are stringified and trimmed. ``thumb_page`` keeps a whole
page number of at least 1 and clears anything else. An empty
``target_folder_id`` clears it. ``roles`` and ``tags`` replace the
drafted list; ``null`` leaves it unchanged.

revision.description: The item's revision the edit was made against.
revision.title: Revision

ProcessingItemUploaded.description: POST /api/processing-items: the item (201 created, 200 for a used Idempotency-Key).

PublisherCreateRequest.description: POST /api/publishers. Emptiness is a domain refusal, not a schema one.

ResearchRefs.description: The Concepts and Arguments the Research Note links to.

pending.description: True while the research index has not caught up with the note; left out when the index could not be read.
pending.title: Pending

confirm.description: Confirms the restore over the Library.
confirm.title: Confirm

Restored.description: ``POST /api/backups/restore``: the new epoch fences the browser's earlier pending work.

credit_name.description: The name as credited on this Work; left out or null: none.

credit_name.description: The new credit; left out or null: none.
credit_name.title: Credit Name

order_index.description: Checked to be an integer, else ignored.
order_index.title: Order Index

RoleScope.description: One Person-role relationship of the Work: its revision, and whether it is live.

SavedView.description: One Saved View: GET list rows, GET by id, POST and PATCH bodies.

revision.description: Advanced by every update; an edit sends it back as `base_revision`.
revision.title: Revision

SavedViewSearch.description: A saved search definition. All five keys are always present.

SavedViewSearchInput.description:
A search definition as the endpoint accepts it.

All five keys are required strings. Extra keys are ignored. ``mode`` is
trimmed by the domain before it must be ``all``, ``advanced``, or ``tag``,
so the schema types it as a string; the allowed values, field lengths,
and mode/field combinations are domain refusals (400).

SavedViewUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /api/saved-views/{id}. Omit a field, or send JSON null, to leave it unchanged.

Sending neither field (or only nulls) is a domain refusal
(``Nothing to update.``). ``base_revision`` is the ``revision`` the editor
opened on; any other current revision is ``409`` with code
``revision_conflict`` (#873).

base_revision.description: The `revision` the edit was opened on.
base_revision.title: Base Revision

created_at.description: When the archive was made, from its manifest.
created_at.title: Created At

StorageDatabase.description: The database half of the Library (storage-architecture §9.2), read-only.

host.description: Host name or address; 'local socket' for a Unix socket.
host.title: Host

StorageFilesystem.description: Facts about the filesystem that holds the root, measured, not assumed.

filesystem_type.description: The type the platform reports, such as ext4 or apfs.

network.description: Whether the type is known to be a network mount (§7.4); FUSE types are uncertain.
network.title: Network

case_sensitive.description: Measured with probe files; null when not measured.

normalization.description: Unicode names: preserved (NFC and NFD are two names), insensitive (either finds the other), normalized (the filesystem rewrites names). Null when not measured.

directory_fsync.description: Whether directory fsync works here, as the root's first probe recorded it.

relocation_state.description: none, or the phase of a storage move the marker records (unknown when it names none).

missing.description: Named objects the data root does not have.

orphans.description: Objects nothing ever named, found by the orphan sweep, waiting for cleanup.

held.description: Objects a restore keeps; never removed automatically.
held.title: Held

resolved.title: Resolved

editable_in_app.description: Always false: the root is paired with the database, so it changes only on the host, with a storage move or a new installation and a Library restore.

objects.description: Null when the counts could not be read (the database or the store was unavailable).

op_id.description: A UUID the device minted for this operation.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone.

depends_on.description: Up to 16 op_ids that must be ledgered first.

SyncResult.description:
The ledgered result: ``ACKNOWLEDGED`` with the family's fields, or a refusal code.

Once an operation is ledgered, a retry with the same ``op_id`` and body answers
the ledgered status and result. A refusal that is not ledgered (an unmet
``depends_on``, for one) may answer differently on a later retry.

Tag.description: ``GET /api/tags``: a Tag with its aliases, by name.

color.description: A ``#rrggbb`` colour; left out: the default colour.
